svg.title: Built by OneReign
svg.desc: Footer. The OneReign logo, a hexagonal emblem with the words OneReign and Where possibility becomes inevitable, is drawn as a source node that ASSERTS a claim: Faultline was built by OneReign. Every claim in Faultline carries its source. So does Faultline.
